title: Design System: 天赋测试 · 彩色挑战卡

scope.authority: User-approved independent Talent world; global course design does not apply to these files/routes.

title.purpose: 卡片与游戏工作区标题。

navigation.purpose: 细长 header 的 13px 导航与语言控件。

shadows.name: talent-card
shadows.purpose: 彩色卡片与游戏面短软抬升。

motion.name: gameplay-signal
motion.value: Immediate CSS state change; no color transition

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: 移除卡片倾斜和动画，保留 translateY(stagger)，背面切换与键盘仍可操作。

layout.hallAlignment: margin-block: auto inside the column flex content
layout.shellFlow: min-height: 100dvh; header/footer do not shrink; natural scrolling for short viewports or long card backs
layout.supportDivider: 1px left border; 32px left padding on the best section

componentStates.focus: 2px Ink outline, offset 4px; reaction 3px currentColor outline, offset -8px
componentStates.disabled: Buttons opacity .4; default cursor. aria-disabled links keep readable foreground.
componentStates.cardSides: Same color/shape; hidden side is inert and aria-hidden; flip returns focus to visible side flip control. Hidden side is absolutely positioned; visible long rules expand the card naturally.
componentStates.reaction: waiting Panel/Ink; green Talent Go/White; early and invalid Reaction Card/Talent Wait; sample Reaction Card/Ink
componentStates.memory: Lit and active cells Talent Go/White; disabled during playback. Each level has an independent random sequence, increasing from 1 to 20 cells; score is the number of fully completed levels.
componentStates.timed: Neutral answers; four stimulus inks; correct/wrong text signals.
componentStates.auth: Public hall; games redirect to login with next; scores require login; loading/error use real state.
componentStates.results: Local score while saving; server score after save; offline retry, expired/session text, disabled replay during save.
componentStates.leaderboard: Identity-color selected tab plus underline; own row Panel plus text; real loading/error/empty/refresh states.

actionArrow.uses: Card front/back, return, leaderboard and footer; aria-hidden.

extensions.rasterAssets: No shipping raster assets; semantic HTML/CSS/SVG. Approved comp is directional evidence only.

narrative.overview:
天赋测试是一组可以拿起、翻面和开始挑战的彩色卡片。暖白页面、深色文字、四块柔和色面与短软阴影构成独立于课程的界面；系统字型和清晰描边保留轻量、直接的操作感。

色面标识挑战身份，深色按钮标识主要行动，游戏信号只表达当前状态。大厅保持小号品牌与简短提示，游戏页把题目、计时和答案放在主要视线中；所有成绩、错误和登录状态来自真实业务。
keyCharacteristics: 薄荷绿、奶油黄、淡紫、浅蓝分别对应四种挑战。
四卡高低错落、轻微倾斜；悬停归正，翻面查看规则。
暖白底、深色文字、细着色边框与短软阴影。
系统无衬线与 tabular-nums 保持阅读、计时和成绩清楚。
手机保留横向选择、翻面、语言与账号入口，减少动态时仍可操作。
用户要求整体约缩小两成：1000px 卡组、412–446px 窄长桌面卡高与 56px 细长 header。

rules.name: The Challenge Identity Rule
rules.body: 柔和卡面表示挑战身份；可点击绿色、错误红色与颜色干扰文字表示游戏状态。两者不可互换。

rules.name: The Immediate Signal Rule
rules.body: 反应变绿和记忆亮格直接切换，不加入颜色过渡；翻面与选择动画不进入玩法计时。

rules.name: The Small Brand Rule
rules.body: 品牌使用紧凑文字与四颜色 SVG；大厅大标题保留为辅助技术可读的隐藏 h1。

rules.name: The Retained Stagger Rule
rules.body: 悬停或键盘聚焦时归正并上移 4px，保留每项卡片的高低差；减少动态时去掉倾斜、保留静态错落。

dos: Do 在天赋路由及其专属 UI 文件中使用本设计，课程继续读取全局设计。
Do 保留四项卡片的身份色、错落、倾角和翻面后的同色背面。
Do 用深色实心按钮表达开始或重试，用描边或下划线操作表达次级行动。
Do 为信号保留文字、符号或数字，为选择保留 aria-pressed、下划线和键盘焦点。
